caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular stone or concrete plaque with a textured gray surface and three parallel horizontal lines near the top. Centered towards the upper part of the plaque, there is text in uppercase serif letters reading "MANHATTAN WELLS" in gray and "NEW - YORK" in a larger font in a deep blue color. Beneath the text, in the center of the plaque, there is a decorative blue emblem resembling a stylized symmetrical floral or abstract butterfly motif with rounded and tapered shapes. The entire plaque is set on a plain, off-white background with no other objects or markings except for a small, faint signature reading "Chas. Cossell" in the lower left corner outside the main plaque area.
